question:
If A + B means A is the husband of B, A#B means A is the brother of B, A @ B means B is the son of A and A $ B means B is the daughter of A, then from the given options, choose what is the meaning of the below statement:

R # P + Q @ S $ T

options.text: R is the grandfather of S
P is the uncle of T
S is the grandson of P
T is the granddaughter of Q
